feeSharing.setup: /admin/treasury -> 'Launch a coin': ONE transaction = create_v2 + create_fee_sharing_config + update_fee_shares_v2 (locked) + 0.01 SOL buy, signed by the dedicated launch wallet and a browser-generated mint, so fees reach the treasury from the first trade (needs the project lookup table).

coin.registration: POST /api/admin/ecosystem/token {mintAddress} -> PENDING_VERIFICATION, then POST /api/admin/tokens/{id}/verify after review -> LIVE. Buybacks refuse to run until DYNASTY is LIVE with a fresh market snapshot.
